Sub LogLine(t As String)
    ' Writes AUTO3D_log.txt next to the macro, to see what SOLIDWORKS did at each step.
    Static started As Boolean
    Dim fn As Integer, path As String
    On Error Resume Next
    path = swApp.GetCurrentMacroPathFolder & "\AUTO3D_log.txt"
    fn = FreeFile
    If started Then
        Open path For Append As #fn
    Else
        Open path For Output As #fn
        started = True
    End If
    Print #fn, t
    Close #fn
    Err.Clear
End Sub

Function FindPlanes() As Boolean
    ' Planes(0) faces Z, Planes(1) faces Y, Planes(2) faces X, whatever the template calls
    ' them, so a Z-up template builds the same part as the standard Y-up one.
    Dim f As Object, n As Long, k As Long, nv As Variant, found(2) As Object
    Set f = Part.FirstFeature
    Do While Not f Is Nothing And n < 3
        If f.GetTypeName2 = "RefPlane" Then
            Set Planes(n) = f
            n = n + 1
            nv = PlaneNormal(f)
            If IsArray(nv) Then LogLine "plane " & f.Name & " normal " & Format(nv(0), "0.00") & ", " & Format(nv(1), "0.00") & ", " & Format(nv(2), "0.00") Else LogLine "plane " & f.Name & " normal unknown"
            If IsArray(nv) Then
                For k = 0 To 2
                    If Abs(nv(2 - k)) > 0.99 Then Set found(k) = f
                Next k
            End If
        End If
        Set f = f.GetNextFeature
    Loop
    If Not found(0) Is Nothing And Not found(1) Is Nothing And Not found(2) Is Nothing Then
        For k = 0 To 2
            Set Planes(k) = found(k)
        Next k
    End If
    LogLine "using " & Planes(0).Name & " (Z), " & Planes(1).Name & " (Y), " & Planes(2).Name & " (X)"
    FindPlanes = (n = 3)
End Function

Function D3(a As Double, b As Double, c As Double) As Variant
    ' SOLIDWORKS math objects need a real Double array; Array() gives Variants and reads as zeros.
    Dim d(2) As Double
    d(0) = a: d(1) = b: d(2) = c
    D3 = d
End Function

Function PlaneNormal(pf As Object) As Variant
    ' Normal of a reference plane in model space, or Empty
    Dim mu As Object, v As Object, a As Variant
    On Error Resume Next
    Set mu = swApp.GetMathUtility
    Set v = mu.CreateVector(D3(0, 0, 1))
    Set v = v.MultiplyTransform(pf.GetSpecificFeature2.Transform)
    a = v.ArrayData
    If IsArray(a) Then
        If Abs(a(0)) + Abs(a(1)) + Abs(a(2)) > 0.5 Then PlaneNormal = a
    End If
    Err.Clear
End Function

Function PlaneOrigin(pf As Object) As Variant
    Dim mu As Object, p As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    Set mu = swApp.GetMathUtility
    Set p = mu.CreatePoint(D3(0, 0, 0))
    Set p = p.MultiplyTransform(pf.GetSpecificFeature2.Transform)
    PlaneOrigin = p.ArrayData
    Err.Clear
End Function

Function OffsetPlane(idx As Long, offM As Double) As Object
    Dim pl As Object, o As Variant
    CurPlane = idx
    If offM <= 0 Then
        Set OffsetPlane = Planes(idx)
        Exit Function
    End If
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    Planes(idx).Select2 False, 0
    Set pl = fm.InsertRefPlane(8, offM, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    ' The offset goes along the template plane's own normal; put it on the +X/+Y/+Z side.
    o = PlaneOrigin(pl)
    If IsArray(o) Then
        If o(2 - idx) < 0 Then
            Part.ClearSelection2 True
            pl.Select2 False, 0
            Part.Extension.DeleteSelection2 0
            Part.ClearSelection2 True
            Planes(idx).Select2 False, 0
            Set pl = fm.InsertRefPlane(8 + 256, offM, 0, 0, 0, 0)
        End If
    End If
    Set OffsetPlane = pl
End Function

Sub BeginSketch(pl As Object)
    Dim ok As Boolean
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    If pl Is Nothing Then
        LogLine "sketch: no plane"
    Else
        ok = pl.Select2(False, 0)
        LogLine "sketch on " & pl.Name & " selected=" & ok
    End If
    sm.InsertSketch True
    LogLine "  active sketch: " & Not (sm.ActiveSketch Is Nothing)
    sm.AddToDB = True
    sm.DisplayWhenAdded = False
    SketchAxes pl
End Sub

Sub SketchAxes(pl As Object)
    ' How this plan's sketch axes (u, v) land in the SOLIDWORKS sketch.
    ' Plan: Front u=X v=Y, Top u=X v=-Z, Right u=-Z v=Y (model X, Y, Z).
    ' A sketch on a plane uses that plane's own x and y axes, read from its transform.
    Dim uu As Variant, vv As Variant, ax As Variant, ay As Variant, o As Variant, d As Double
    Select Case CurPlane
        Case 0: uu = D3(1, 0, 0): vv = D3(0, 1, 0)
        Case 1: uu = D3(1, 0, 0): vv = D3(0, 0, -1)
        Case Else: uu = D3(0, 0, -1): vv = D3(0, 1, 0)
    End Select
    Kox = 0: Koy = 0: Kux = 1: Kuy = 0: Kvx = 0: Kvy = 1: KMir = 1
    ax = PlaneAxis(pl, 1, 0, 0)
    ay = PlaneAxis(pl, 0, 1, 0)
    o = PlaneOrigin(pl)
    If IsArray(ax) And IsArray(ay) And IsArray(o) Then
        LogLine "  plane x=(" & Format(ax(0), "0.00") & ", " & Format(ax(1), "0.00") & ", " & Format(ax(2), "0.00") & ") y=(" & _
            Format(ay(0), "0.00") & ", " & Format(ay(1), "0.00") & ", " & Format(ay(2), "0.00") & ")"
        Kux = Dot3(uu, ax): Kuy = Dot3(uu, ay)
        Kvx = Dot3(vv, ax): Kvy = Dot3(vv, ay)
        Kox = -Dot3(o, ax): Koy = -Dot3(o, ay)
        d = Kux * Kvy - Kuy * Kvx
        If Abs(d) < 0.5 Then
            LogLine "  sketch axes not usable, kept as drawn"
            Kox = 0: Koy = 0: Kux = 1: Kuy = 0: Kvx = 0: Kvy = 1
        ElseIf d < 0 Then
            KMir = -1
        End If
    Else
        LogLine "  plane axes unknown, kept as drawn"
    End If
    LogLine "  axes u=(" & Format(Kux, "0.00") & ", " & Format(Kuy, "0.00") & ") v=(" & Format(Kvx, "0.00") & ", " & Format(Kvy, "0.00") & ") o=(" & Format(Kox * 1000, "0.00") & ", " & Format(Koy * 1000, "0.00") & ")"
End Sub

Function PlaneAxis(pf As Object, x As Double, y As Double, z As Double) As Variant
    ' One axis of a reference plane in model space, or Empty
    Dim mu As Object, v As Object, a As Variant
    On Error Resume Next
    Set mu = swApp.GetMathUtility
    Set v = mu.CreateVector(D3(x, y, z))
    Set v = v.MultiplyTransform(pf.GetSpecificFeature2.Transform)
    a = v.ArrayData
    If IsArray(a) Then
        If Abs(a(0)) + Abs(a(1)) + Abs(a(2)) > 0.5 Then PlaneAxis = a
    End If
    Err.Clear
End Function

Function Dot3(a As Variant, b As Variant) As Double
    Dot3 = a(0) * b(0) + a(1) * b(1) + a(2) * b(2)
End Function

Function SX(u As Double, v As Double) As Double
    SX = Kox + u * Kux + v * Kvx
End Function

Function SY(u As Double, v As Double) As Double
    SY = Koy + u * Kuy + v * Kvy
End Function

Sub SkLine(u1 As Double, v1 As Double, u2 As Double, v2 As Double)
    If sm.CreateLine(SX(u1, v1), SY(u1, v1), 0, SX(u2, v2), SY(u2, v2), 0) Is Nothing Then LogLine "  line failed"
End Sub

Sub SkCenterLine(u1 As Double, v1 As Double, u2 As Double, v2 As Double)
    sm.CreateCenterLine SX(u1, v1), SY(u1, v1), 0, SX(u2, v2), SY(u2, v2), 0
End Sub

Sub SkCircle(cu As Double, cv As Double, r As Double)
    If sm.CreateCircleByRadius(SX(cu, cv), SY(cu, cv), 0, r) Is Nothing Then LogLine "  circle failed"
End Sub

Sub SkArc(cu As Double, cv As Double, au As Double, av As Double, bu As Double, bv As Double, d As Long)
    If sm.CreateArc(SX(cu, cv), SY(cu, cv), 0, SX(au, av), SY(au, av), 0, SX(bu, bv), SY(bu, bv), 0, d * KMir) Is Nothing Then LogLine "  arc failed"
End Sub

Function EndSketch() As String
    sm.AddToDB = False
    sm.DisplayWhenAdded = True
    On Error Resume Next
    LogLine "  segments: " & sm.ActiveSketch.GetSketchSegmentCount
    On Error GoTo 0
    sm.InsertSketch True
    EndSketch = Part.FeatureByPositionReverse(0).Name
    LogLine "  closed as " & EndSketch
End Function

Sub DefineAllSketches()
    ' After the part is built and checked: Tools > Dimensions > Fully Define Sketch on every
    ' sketch, measured from the origin, so sketches turn black with their sizes shown.
    ' Relations: coincident, horizontal, vertical, tangent, perpendicular, concentric.
    ' Any sketch that cannot be defined is left as drawn.
    Dim f As Object, s As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    Set f = Part.FirstFeature
    Do While Not f Is Nothing
        If f.GetTypeName2 = "ProfileFeature" Then DefineOne f
        Set s = f.GetFirstSubFeature
        Do While Not s Is Nothing
            If s.GetTypeName2 = "ProfileFeature" Then DefineOne s
            Set s = s.GetNextSubFeature
        Loop
        Set f = f.GetNextFeature
    Loop
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    Part.EditRebuild3
    Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

Sub DefineOne(sk As Object)
    On Error Resume Next
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    If Not sk.Select2(False, 0) Then Exit Sub
    Part.EditSketch
    If sm.ActiveSketch Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    Part.Extension.SelectByID2 "Point1@Origin", "EXTSKETCHPOINT", 0, 0, 0, False, 6, Nothing, 0
    sm.FullyDefineSketch True, True, 606, True, 1, Nothing, 1, Nothing, 1, 1
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    sm.InsertSketch True
    Err.Clear
End Sub

Function Matches(expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double) As Boolean
    Dim mp As Object, c As Variant, v As Double, dx As Double, dy As Double, dz As Double
    Matches = False
    On Error Resume Next
    Set mp = Part.Extension.CreateMassProperty
    v = mp.Volume * 1E+09
    c = mp.CenterOfMass
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        Err.Clear
        Exit Function
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    If Not IsArray(c) Or v <= 0 Then Exit Function
    dx = c(0) * 1000 - ex: dy = c(1) * 1000 - ey: dz = c(2) * 1000 - ez
    Matches = (Abs(v - VolAdj - expV) / expV <= 0.0005) And (dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz <= 0.0025)
End Function

Function PickSketch(nm As String) As Boolean
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    PickSketch = Part.Extension.SelectByID2(nm, "SKETCH", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
End Function

Sub Solid(label As String, nm As String, isCut As Boolean, sd As Boolean, t1 As Long, t2 As Long, d1 As Double, _
          dang As Double, t0 As Long, startM As Double, firstDir As Boolean, _
          expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double)
    Dim f As Object, a As Long, b As Long, c As Long, dirFlag As Boolean, fs As Boolean, dOut As Boolean
    Dim useDraft As Boolean, nA As Long, nB As Long, made As Boolean, got As String
    useDraft = (dang > 0)
    nA = 0: If t0 = 3 Then nA = 1
    nB = 0: If useDraft Then nB = 1
    For a = 0 To nA
        For b = 0 To nB
            For c = 0 To 1
                fs = (a = 1): dOut = (b = 1)
                dirFlag = firstDir: If c = 1 Then dirFlag = Not firstDir
                PickSketch nm
                Set f = Nothing
                On Error Resume Next
                If isCut Then
                    Set f = fm.FeatureCut4(sd, False, dirFlag, t1, t2, d1, 0.01, useDraft, False, dOut, False, _
                        IIf(useDraft, dang, 0.0175), 0.0175, False, False, False, False, False, True, True, _
                        True, True, False, t0, startM, fs, False)
                Else
                    Set f = fm.FeatureExtrusion2(sd, False, dirFlag, t1, t2, d1, 0, useDraft, False, dOut, False, _
                        IIf(useDraft, dang, 0.0175), 0.0175, False, False, False, False, True, True, True, _
                        t0, startM, fs)
                End If
                On Error GoTo 0
                If Not f Is Nothing Then
                    made = True
                    Part.EditRebuild3
                    If Matches(expV, ex, ey, ez) Then
                        On Error Resume Next
                        f.Name = label
                        On Error GoTo 0
                        Exit Sub
                    End If
                    got = VolumeNow()
                    Part.EditUndo2 1
                    Part.EditRebuild3
                End If
            Next c
        Next b
    Next a
    LogLine "  " & label & ": made=" & made & " got " & got
    If made Then
        Problems = Problems & label & " (got " & got & ", expected " & Format(expV, "0.0") & " mm3 at " & _
            Format(ex, "0.00") & ", " & Format(ey, "0.00") & ", " & Format(ez, "0.00") & ")" & vbCrLf
    Else
        Problems = Problems & label & " (SOLIDWORKS did not create it, sketch " & nm & ")" & vbCrLf
    End If
End Sub

Function VolNow() As Double
    Dim mp As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    Set mp = Part.Extension.CreateMassProperty
    VolNow = mp.Volume * 1E+09
    Err.Clear
End Function

Function VolumeNow() As String
    Dim mp As Object
    VolumeNow = "none"
    On Error Resume Next
    Set mp = Part.Extension.CreateMassProperty
    Dim c As Variant
    c = mp.CenterOfMass
    VolumeNow = Format(mp.Volume * 1E+09, "0.0") & " mm3 at " & Format(c(0) * 1000, "0.00") & ", " & _
        Format(c(1) * 1000, "0.00") & ", " & Format(c(2) * 1000, "0.00")
    Err.Clear
End Function

Sub Revolve(label As String, nm As String, isCut As Boolean, ang As Double, expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double)
    Dim f As Object, c As Long
    For c = 0 To 1
        PickSketch nm
        Set f = fm.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, isCut, (c = 1), False, 0, 0, ang, 0, False, False, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
        If Not f Is Nothing Then
            Part.EditRebuild3
            If Matches(expV, ex, ey, ez) Then
                On Error Resume Next
                f.Name = label
                On Error GoTo 0
                Exit Sub
            End If
            Part.EditUndo2 1
            Part.EditRebuild3
        End If
    Next c
    Problems = Problems & label & vbCrLf
End Sub

Function WizFlag(Optional ByVal v As Integer = -1) As Boolean
    ' Remembers whether the last hole was made by Hole Wizard, so its counterbore step is skipped.
    Static made As Boolean
    If v >= 0 Then made = (v = 1)
    WizFlag = made
End Function

Sub AddHolePoints(f As Object, p As Variant)
    ' Put the remaining hole centres (model x,y,z in metres) into the Hole Wizard position sketch.
    Dim s As Object, sk As Object, xf As Object, mu As Object, a As Variant, q As Variant, k As Long, n As Long
    On Error Resume Next
    Set s = f.GetFirstSubFeature
    Do While Not s Is Nothing
        If s.GetTypeName2 = "ProfileFeature" Then Exit Do
        Set s = s.GetNextSubFeature
    Loop
    If s Is Nothing Then
        LogLine "  hole positions: no position sketch"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Set sk = s.GetSpecificFeature2
    Set xf = sk.ModelToSketchTransform
    Set mu = swApp.GetMathUtility
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    s.Select2 False, 0
    Part.EditSketch
    sm.AddToDB = True
    For k = 1 To UBound(p)
        q = Split(p(k), ",")
        a = mu.CreatePoint(D3(Val(q(0)), Val(q(1)), Val(q(2)))).MultiplyTransform(xf).ArrayData
        If Not sm.CreatePoint(a(0), a(1), 0) Is Nothing Then n = n + 1
    Next k
    sm.AddToDB = False
    sm.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    Part.ForceRebuild3 False
    LogLine "  hole positions: 1 + " & n & " of " & UBound(p)
    Err.Clear
End Sub

Function MatchesLoose(expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double) As Boolean
    ' Hole Wizard uses standard drill and tap sizes and drill points, so allow a little more.
    Dim mp As Object, c As Variant, v As Double, dx As Double, dy As Double, dz As Double
    MatchesLoose = False
    On Error Resume Next
    Set mp = Part.Extension.CreateMassProperty
    v = mp.Volume * 1E+09
    c = mp.CenterOfMass
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        Err.Clear
        Exit Function
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    If Not IsArray(c) Or v <= 0 Then Exit Function
    dx = c(0) * 1000 - ex: dy = c(1) * 1000 - ey: dz = c(2) * 1000 - ez
    MatchesLoose = (Abs(v - expV) / expV <= 0.005) And (dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz <= 0.25)
End Function

Function HoleWiz(label As String, gtype As Long, fastener As Long, size As String, thru As Boolean, firstEnd As Long, _
                 dia As Double, depth As Double, vals As String, pts As String, dx As Double, dy As Double, dz As Double, _
                 expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double) As Boolean
    ' Hole Wizard, standard JIS (9). Each hole is picked on the face where it starts.
    ' Through holes try Up To Next (2), then Through All (1); the end condition is read back.
    Dim v As Variant, p As Variant, q As Variant, k As Long, tries As Long, endT As Long, f As Object
    Dim a(11) As Double
    HoleWiz = False
    v = Split(vals, ",")
    For k = 0 To 11
        a(k) = Val(v(k))
    Next k
    p = Split(pts, ";")
    For tries = 0 To 1
        If thru Then
            endT = firstEnd
            If tries = 1 Then endT = IIf(firstEnd = 2, 1, 2)
            If gtype = 4 Then a(7) = IIf(endT = 1, 1, 2)
        Else
            If tries = 1 Then Exit Function
            endT = 0
        End If
        ' Hole Wizard takes one position from the selection; the others are added to its sketch.
        Part.ClearSelection2 True
        q = Split(p(0), ",")
        Part.Extension.SelectByRay Val(q(0)) - dx * 0.0001, Val(q(1)) - dy * 0.0001, Val(q(2)) - dz * 0.0001, _
            dx, dy, dz, 0.0002, 2, False, 0, 0
        Set f = Nothing
        On Error Resume Next
        Set f = fm.HoleWizard5(gtype, 9, fastener, size, endT, dia, depth, -1, a(0), a(1), a(2), a(3), a(4), a(5), _
            a(6), a(7), a(8), a(9), a(10), a(11), "", False, True, True, True, True, False)
        On Error GoTo 0
        If Not f Is Nothing Then
            If UBound(p) > 0 Then AddHolePoints f, p
            Part.EditRebuild3
            If MatchesLoose(expV, ex, ey, ez) And (Not thru Or EndIs(f, endT)) Then
                ' Standard drill points and sizes change the volume a little; later checks allow for it.
                VolAdj = VolNow() - expV
                On Error Resume Next
                f.Name = label
                On Error GoTo 0
                Part.ClearSelection2 True
                HoleWiz = True
                Exit Function
            End If
            ' Delete exactly this hole and its position sketch; Undo could remove earlier features.
            On Error Resume Next
            Part.ClearSelection2 True
            f.Select2 False, 0
            Part.Extension.DeleteSelection2 1
            On Error GoTo 0
            Part.EditRebuild3
        End If
    Next tries
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
End Function

Function EndIs(f As Object, endT As Long) As Boolean
    ' A small hole barely changes the volume, so check the end condition itself:
    ' SOLIDWORKS falls back to Blind when it does not take the one asked for.
    Dim d As Object
    EndIs = True
    On Error Resume Next
    Set d = f.GetDefinition
    If Not d Is Nothing Then EndIs = (d.EndCondition = endT)
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

Sub PickEdge(x As Double, y As Double, z As Double)
    ' Remember the edge for a retry, then select it.
    EdgePts = EdgePts & Trim(Str(x)) & "," & Trim(Str(y)) & "," & Trim(Str(z)) & ";"
    PickOne x, y, z
End Sub

Sub PickOne(x As Double, y As Double, z As Double)
    ' Pick by geometry so the result does not depend on the current view.
    Dim b As Variant, e As Variant, p As Variant, sd As Object, i As Long
    Dim dx As Double, dy As Double, dz As Double
    b = Part.GetBodies2(0, False)
    If Not IsArray(b) Then Exit Sub ' no solid yet: an earlier feature failed
    e = b(0).GetEdges
    Set sd = Part.SelectionManager.CreateSelectData
    sd.Mark = 1
    For i = 0 To UBound(e)
        p = e(i).GetClosestPointOn(x, y, z)
        dx = p(0) - x: dy = p(1) - y: dz = p(2) - z
        If dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz < 0.000000000001 Then
            e(i).Select4 True, sd
            Exit Sub
        End If
    Next i
End Sub

Function MakeFinish(isFillet As Boolean, size As Double) As Object
    Dim a0(0) As Double, v As Variant
    a0(0) = 0
    v = a0
    On Error Resume Next
    If isFillet Then
        Set MakeFinish = fm.FeatureFillet3(195, size, size, 0, 0, 0, 0, v, v, v, v, v, v, v)
    Else
        Set MakeFinish = fm.InsertFeatureChamfer(6, 1, size, 0.785398163397448, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    End If
    Err.Clear
End Function

Sub SelectPts(pts As String)
    Dim p As Variant, q As Variant, k As Long
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    p = Split(pts, ";")
    For k = 0 To UBound(p)
        If p(k) <> "" Then
            q = Split(p(k), ",")
            PickOne Val(q(0)), Val(q(1)), Val(q(2))
        End If
    Next k
End Sub

Sub Finish(isFillet As Boolean, label As String, size As Double, expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double)
    ' All picked edges at once. If SOLIDWORKS refuses, keep the edges it accepts one by one
    ' (tested, then made as one feature) and leave the rest sharp.
    Dim f As Object, pts As String, keep As String, p As Variant, k As Long, n As Long, skipped As Long
    pts = EdgePts
    EdgePts = ""
    Set f = MakeFinish(isFillet, size)
    If Not f Is Nothing Then
        Part.EditRebuild3
        f.Name = label
        If Not Matches(expV, ex, ey, ez) Then LogLine "  " & label & ": made, volume " & VolumeNow()
        Exit Sub
    End If
    LogLine "  " & label & ": refused for all edges, trying one by one"
    p = Split(pts, ";")
    For k = 0 To UBound(p)
        If p(k) <> "" Then
            n = n + 1
            SelectPts keep & p(k) & ";"
            Set f = MakeFinish(isFillet, size)
            If f Is Nothing Then
                skipped = skipped + 1
            Else
                keep = keep & p(k) & ";"
                Part.ClearSelection2 True
                f.Select2 False, 0
                Part.Extension.DeleteSelection2 0
                Part.EditRebuild3
            End If
        End If
    Next k
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    If keep <> "" Then
        SelectPts keep
        Set f = MakeFinish(isFillet, size)
        Part.EditRebuild3
        If Not f Is Nothing Then f.Name = label
    End If
    If keep = "" Or f Is Nothing Then
        Problems = Problems & label & " (SOLIDWORKS refused every edge)" & vbCrLf
    ElseIf skipped > 0 Then
        Problems = Problems & label & " (left sharp on " & skipped & " of " & n & " edges)" & vbCrLf
    End If
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
End Sub

Sub FinishFillet(label As String, r As Double, expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double)
    Finish True, label, r, expV, ex, ey, ez
End Sub

Sub FinishChamfer(label As String, d As Double, expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double)
    Finish False, label, d, expV, ex, ey, ez
End Sub

flange.json.macro:
' AUTO DESIGN 3D macro for SOLIDWORKS 2018 (build 2026-11-16b)
' Tools > Macro > Run, choose this .swb file (or paste it into a new macro).
' It builds the part, then saves Pipe_Flange.SLDPRT next to this macro.
Option Explicit
Dim swApp As Object
Dim Part As Object
Dim fm As Object
Dim sm As Object
Dim Planes(2) As Object
Dim Problems As String
Dim CurPlane As Long
Dim Kox As Double, Koy As Double, Kux As Double, Kuy As Double, Kvx As Double, Kvy As Double, KMir As Long
Dim EdgePts As String, VolAdj As Double

Sub main()
    Dim tpl As String, folder As String, target As String
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    tpl = swApp.GetUserPreferenceStringValue(8)
    If tpl = "" Then tpl = swApp.GetDocumentTemplate(1, "", 0, 0, 0)
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument(tpl, 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Cannot create a new part. Set the default part template in System Options."
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Set fm = Part.FeatureManager
    Set sm = Part.SketchManager
    If Not FindPlanes() Then
        MsgBox "Front, Top and Right planes were not found in the template."
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Step1
    Step2
    Step3
    DefineAllSketches
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    Part.EditRebuild3
    folder = swApp.GetCurrentMacroPathFolder
    target = folder & "\Pipe_Flange.SLDPRT"
    Part.SaveAs3 target, 0, 1
    If Problems = "" Then
        MsgBox "Done. All features match the STEP model." & vbCrLf & target
    Else
        MsgBox "Saved, but check these features:" & vbCrLf & Problems & vbCrLf & target
    End If
End Sub

Sub Step1()
    Dim nm As String
    BeginSketch OffsetPlane(0, 0.0)
    SkLine 0.025, 0.0, 0.06, 0.0
    SkLine 0.06, 0.0, 0.06, 0.014
    SkLine 0.06, 0.014, 0.035, 0.014
    SkLine 0.035, 0.014, 0.035, 0.034
    SkLine 0.035, 0.034, 0.025, 0.034
    SkLine 0.025, 0.034, 0.025, 0.0
    SkCenterLine 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.1
    nm = EndSketch()
    Revolve "Flange body", nm, False, 6.28318530718, 168546.4459, 0.0, 10.8024, 0.0
End Sub

Sub Step2()
    Dim nm As String
    BeginSketch OffsetPlane(1, 0.014)
    SkCircle 0.0475, 0.0, 0.0055
    SkCircle 0.02375, 0.04113620668, 0.0055
    SkCircle -0.02375, 0.04113620668, 0.0055
    SkCircle -0.0475, 0.0, 0.0055
    SkCircle -0.02375, -0.04113620668, 0.0055
    SkCircle 0.02375, -0.04113620668, 0.0055
    nm = EndSketch()
    Solid "Bolt holes", nm, True, True, 1, 0, 0.01, 0.0, 0, 0.0, True, 160563.6589, -0.0, 10.9915, 0.0
End Sub

Sub Step3()
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    PickEdge -0.025, 0.034, -0.0
    FinishChamfer "Bore chamfer", 0.002, 160241.1221, -0.0, 10.9465, -0.0
End Sub

Sub LogLine(t As String)
    ' Writes AUTO3D_log.txt next to the macro, to see what SOLIDWORKS did at each step.
    Static started As Boolean
    Dim fn As Integer, path As String
    On Error Resume Next
    path = swApp.GetCurrentMacroPathFolder & "\AUTO3D_log.txt"
    fn = FreeFile
    If started Then
        Open path For Append As #fn
    Else
        Open path For Output As #fn
        started = True
    End If
    Print #fn, t
    Close #fn
    Err.Clear
End Sub

Function FindPlanes() As Boolean
    ' Planes(0) faces Z, Planes(1) faces Y, Planes(2) faces X, whatever the template calls
    ' them, so a Z-up template builds the same part as the standard Y-up one.
    Dim f As Object, n As Long, k As Long, nv As Variant, found(2) As Object
    Set f = Part.FirstFeature
    Do While Not f Is Nothing And n < 3
        If f.GetTypeName2 = "RefPlane" Then
            Set Planes(n) = f
            n = n + 1
            nv = PlaneNormal(f)
            If IsArray(nv) Then LogLine "plane " & f.Name & " normal " & Format(nv(0), "0.00") & ", " & Format(nv(1), "0.00") & ", " & Format(nv(2), "0.00") Else LogLine "plane " & f.Name & " normal unknown"
            If IsArray(nv) Then
                For k = 0 To 2
                    If Abs(nv(2 - k)) > 0.99 Then Set found(k) = f
                Next k
            End If
        End If
        Set f = f.GetNextFeature
    Loop
    If Not found(0) Is Nothing And Not found(1) Is Nothing And Not found(2) Is Nothing Then
        For k = 0 To 2
            Set Planes(k) = found(k)
        Next k
    End If
    LogLine "using " & Planes(0).Name & " (Z), " & Planes(1).Name & " (Y), " & Planes(2).Name & " (X)"
    FindPlanes = (n = 3)
End Function

Function D3(a As Double, b As Double, c As Double) As Variant
    ' SOLIDWORKS math objects need a real Double array; Array() gives Variants and reads as zeros.
    Dim d(2) As Double
    d(0) = a: d(1) = b: d(2) = c
    D3 = d
End Function

Function PlaneNormal(pf As Object) As Variant
    ' Normal of a reference plane in model space, or Empty
    Dim mu As Object, v As Object, a As Variant
    On Error Resume Next
    Set mu = swApp.GetMathUtility
    Set v = mu.CreateVector(D3(0, 0, 1))
    Set v = v.MultiplyTransform(pf.GetSpecificFeature2.Transform)
    a = v.ArrayData
    If IsArray(a) Then
        If Abs(a(0)) + Abs(a(1)) + Abs(a(2)) > 0.5 Then PlaneNormal = a
    End If
    Err.Clear
End Function

Function PlaneOrigin(pf As Object) As Variant
    Dim mu As Object, p As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    Set mu = swApp.GetMathUtility
    Set p = mu.CreatePoint(D3(0, 0, 0))
    Set p = p.MultiplyTransform(pf.GetSpecificFeature2.Transform)
    PlaneOrigin = p.ArrayData
    Err.Clear
End Function

Function OffsetPlane(idx As Long, offM As Double) As Object
    Dim pl As Object, o As Variant
    CurPlane = idx
    If offM <= 0 Then
        Set OffsetPlane = Planes(idx)
        Exit Function
    End If
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    Planes(idx).Select2 False, 0
    Set pl = fm.InsertRefPlane(8, offM, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    ' The offset goes along the template plane's own normal; put it on the +X/+Y/+Z side.
    o = PlaneOrigin(pl)
    If IsArray(o) Then
        If o(2 - idx) < 0 Then
            Part.ClearSelection2 True
            pl.Select2 False, 0
            Part.Extension.DeleteSelection2 0
            Part.ClearSelection2 True
            Planes(idx).Select2 False, 0
            Set pl = fm.InsertRefPlane(8 + 256, offM, 0, 0, 0, 0)
        End If
    End If
    Set OffsetPlane = pl
End Function

Sub BeginSketch(pl As Object)
    Dim ok As Boolean
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    If pl Is Nothing Then
        LogLine "sketch: no plane"
    Else
        ok = pl.Select2(False, 0)
        LogLine "sketch on " & pl.Name & " selected=" & ok
    End If
    sm.InsertSketch True
    LogLine "  active sketch: " & Not (sm.ActiveSketch Is Nothing)
    sm.AddToDB = True
    sm.DisplayWhenAdded = False
    SketchAxes pl
End Sub

Sub SketchAxes(pl As Object)
    ' How this plan's sketch axes (u, v) land in the SOLIDWORKS sketch.
    ' Plan: Front u=X v=Y, Top u=X v=-Z, Right u=-Z v=Y (model X, Y, Z).
    ' A sketch on a plane uses that plane's own x and y axes, read from its transform.
    Dim uu As Variant, vv As Variant, ax As Variant, ay As Variant, o As Variant, d As Double
    Select Case CurPlane
        Case 0: uu = D3(1, 0, 0): vv = D3(0, 1, 0)
        Case 1: uu = D3(1, 0, 0): vv = D3(0, 0, -1)
        Case Else: uu = D3(0, 0, -1): vv = D3(0, 1, 0)
    End Select
    Kox = 0: Koy = 0: Kux = 1: Kuy = 0: Kvx = 0: Kvy = 1: KMir = 1
    ax = PlaneAxis(pl, 1, 0, 0)
    ay = PlaneAxis(pl, 0, 1, 0)
    o = PlaneOrigin(pl)
    If IsArray(ax) And IsArray(ay) And IsArray(o) Then
        LogLine "  plane x=(" & Format(ax(0), "0.00") & ", " & Format(ax(1), "0.00") & ", " & Format(ax(2), "0.00") & ") y=(" & _
            Format(ay(0), "0.00") & ", " & Format(ay(1), "0.00") & ", " & Format(ay(2), "0.00") & ")"
        Kux = Dot3(uu, ax): Kuy = Dot3(uu, ay)
        Kvx = Dot3(vv, ax): Kvy = Dot3(vv, ay)
        Kox = -Dot3(o, ax): Koy = -Dot3(o, ay)
        d = Kux * Kvy - Kuy * Kvx
        If Abs(d) < 0.5 Then
            LogLine "  sketch axes not usable, kept as drawn"
            Kox = 0: Koy = 0: Kux = 1: Kuy = 0: Kvx = 0: Kvy = 1
        ElseIf d < 0 Then
            KMir = -1
        End If
    Else
        LogLine "  plane axes unknown, kept as drawn"
    End If
    LogLine "  axes u=(" & Format(Kux, "0.00") & ", " & Format(Kuy, "0.00") & ") v=(" & Format(Kvx, "0.00") & ", " & Format(Kvy, "0.00") & ") o=(" & Format(Kox * 1000, "0.00") & ", " & Format(Koy * 1000, "0.00") & ")"
End Sub

Function PlaneAxis(pf As Object, x As Double, y As Double, z As Double) As Variant
    ' One axis of a reference plane in model space, or Empty
    Dim mu As Object, v As Object, a As Variant
    On Error Resume Next
    Set mu = swApp.GetMathUtility
    Set v = mu.CreateVector(D3(x, y, z))
    Set v = v.MultiplyTransform(pf.GetSpecificFeature2.Transform)
    a = v.ArrayData
    If IsArray(a) Then
        If Abs(a(0)) + Abs(a(1)) + Abs(a(2)) > 0.5 Then PlaneAxis = a
    End If
    Err.Clear
End Function

Function Dot3(a As Variant, b As Variant) As Double
    Dot3 = a(0) * b(0) + a(1) * b(1) + a(2) * b(2)
End Function

Function SX(u As Double, v As Double) As Double
    SX = Kox + u * Kux + v * Kvx
End Function

Function SY(u As Double, v As Double) As Double
    SY = Koy + u * Kuy + v * Kvy
End Function

Sub SkLine(u1 As Double, v1 As Double, u2 As Double, v2 As Double)
    If sm.CreateLine(SX(u1, v1), SY(u1, v1), 0, SX(u2, v2), SY(u2, v2), 0) Is Nothing Then LogLine "  line failed"
End Sub

Sub SkCenterLine(u1 As Double, v1 As Double, u2 As Double, v2 As Double)
    sm.CreateCenterLine SX(u1, v1), SY(u1, v1), 0, SX(u2, v2), SY(u2, v2), 0
End Sub

Sub SkCircle(cu As Double, cv As Double, r As Double)
    If sm.CreateCircleByRadius(SX(cu, cv), SY(cu, cv), 0, r) Is Nothing Then LogLine "  circle failed"
End Sub

Sub SkArc(cu As Double, cv As Double, au As Double, av As Double, bu As Double, bv As Double, d As Long)
    If sm.CreateArc(SX(cu, cv), SY(cu, cv), 0, SX(au, av), SY(au, av), 0, SX(bu, bv), SY(bu, bv), 0, d * KMir) Is Nothing Then LogLine "  arc failed"
End Sub

Function EndSketch() As String
    sm.AddToDB = False
    sm.DisplayWhenAdded = True
    On Error Resume Next
    LogLine "  segments: " & sm.ActiveSketch.GetSketchSegmentCount
    On Error GoTo 0
    sm.InsertSketch True
    EndSketch = Part.FeatureByPositionReverse(0).Name
    LogLine "  closed as " & EndSketch
End Function

Sub DefineAllSketches()
    ' After the part is built and checked: Tools > Dimensions > Fully Define Sketch on every
    ' sketch, measured from the origin, so sketches turn black with their sizes shown.
    ' Relations: coincident, horizontal, vertical, tangent, perpendicular, concentric.
    ' Any sketch that cannot be defined is left as drawn.
    Dim f As Object, s As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    Set f = Part.FirstFeature
    Do While Not f Is Nothing
        If f.GetTypeName2 = "ProfileFeature" Then DefineOne f
        Set s = f.GetFirstSubFeature
        Do While Not s Is Nothing
            If s.GetTypeName2 = "ProfileFeature" Then DefineOne s
            Set s = s.GetNextSubFeature
        Loop
        Set f = f.GetNextFeature
    Loop
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    Part.EditRebuild3
    Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

Sub DefineOne(sk As Object)
    On Error Resume Next
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    If Not sk.Select2(False, 0) Then Exit Sub
    Part.EditSketch
    If sm.ActiveSketch Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    Part.Extension.SelectByID2 "Point1@Origin", "EXTSKETCHPOINT", 0, 0, 0, False, 6, Nothing, 0
    sm.FullyDefineSketch True, True, 606, True, 1, Nothing, 1, Nothing, 1, 1
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    sm.InsertSketch True
    Err.Clear
End Sub

Function Matches(expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double) As Boolean
    Dim mp As Object, c As Variant, v As Double, dx As Double, dy As Double, dz As Double
    Matches = False
    On Error Resume Next
    Set mp = Part.Extension.CreateMassProperty
    v = mp.Volume * 1E+09
    c = mp.CenterOfMass
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        Err.Clear
        Exit Function
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    If Not IsArray(c) Or v <= 0 Then Exit Function
    dx = c(0) * 1000 - ex: dy = c(1) * 1000 - ey: dz = c(2) * 1000 - ez
    Matches = (Abs(v - VolAdj - expV) / expV <= 0.0005) And (dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz <= 0.0025)
End Function

Function PickSketch(nm As String) As Boolean
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    PickSketch = Part.Extension.SelectByID2(nm, "SKETCH", 0, 0, 0, False, 0, Nothing, 0)
End Function

Sub Solid(label As String, nm As String, isCut As Boolean, sd As Boolean, t1 As Long, t2 As Long, d1 As Double, _
          dang As Double, t0 As Long, startM As Double, firstDir As Boolean, _
          expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double)
    Dim f As Object, a As Long, b As Long, c As Long, dirFlag As Boolean, fs As Boolean, dOut As Boolean
    Dim useDraft As Boolean, nA As Long, nB As Long, made As Boolean, got As String
    useDraft = (dang > 0)
    nA = 0: If t0 = 3 Then nA = 1
    nB = 0: If useDraft Then nB = 1
    For a = 0 To nA
        For b = 0 To nB
            For c = 0 To 1
                fs = (a = 1): dOut = (b = 1)
                dirFlag = firstDir: If c = 1 Then dirFlag = Not firstDir
                PickSketch nm
                Set f = Nothing
                On Error Resume Next
                If isCut Then
                    Set f = fm.FeatureCut4(sd, False, dirFlag, t1, t2, d1, 0.01, useDraft, False, dOut, False, _
                        IIf(useDraft, dang, 0.0175), 0.0175, False, False, False, False, False, True, True, _
                        True, True, False, t0, startM, fs, False)
                Else
                    Set f = fm.FeatureExtrusion2(sd, False, dirFlag, t1, t2, d1, 0, useDraft, False, dOut, False, _
                        IIf(useDraft, dang, 0.0175), 0.0175, False, False, False, False, True, True, True, _
                        t0, startM, fs)
                End If
                On Error GoTo 0
                If Not f Is Nothing Then
                    made = True
                    Part.EditRebuild3
                    If Matches(expV, ex, ey, ez) Then
                        On Error Resume Next
                        f.Name = label
                        On Error GoTo 0
                        Exit Sub
                    End If
                    got = VolumeNow()
                    Part.EditUndo2 1
                    Part.EditRebuild3
                End If
            Next c
        Next b
    Next a
    LogLine "  " & label & ": made=" & made & " got " & got
    If made Then
        Problems = Problems & label & " (got " & got & ", expected " & Format(expV, "0.0") & " mm3 at " & _
            Format(ex, "0.00") & ", " & Format(ey, "0.00") & ", " & Format(ez, "0.00") & ")" & vbCrLf
    Else
        Problems = Problems & label & " (SOLIDWORKS did not create it, sketch " & nm & ")" & vbCrLf
    End If
End Sub

Function VolNow() As Double
    Dim mp As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    Set mp = Part.Extension.CreateMassProperty
    VolNow = mp.Volume * 1E+09
    Err.Clear
End Function

Function VolumeNow() As String
    Dim mp As Object
    VolumeNow = "none"
    On Error Resume Next
    Set mp = Part.Extension.CreateMassProperty
    Dim c As Variant
    c = mp.CenterOfMass
    VolumeNow = Format(mp.Volume * 1E+09, "0.0") & " mm3 at " & Format(c(0) * 1000, "0.00") & ", " & _
        Format(c(1) * 1000, "0.00") & ", " & Format(c(2) * 1000, "0.00")
    Err.Clear
End Function

Sub Revolve(label As String, nm As String, isCut As Boolean, ang As Double, expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double)
    Dim f As Object, c As Long
    For c = 0 To 1
        PickSketch nm
        Set f = fm.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, isCut, (c = 1), False, 0, 0, ang, 0, False, False, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
        If Not f Is Nothing Then
            Part.EditRebuild3
            If Matches(expV, ex, ey, ez) Then
                On Error Resume Next
                f.Name = label
                On Error GoTo 0
                Exit Sub
            End If
            Part.EditUndo2 1
            Part.EditRebuild3
        End If
    Next c
    Problems = Problems & label & vbCrLf
End Sub

Function WizFlag(Optional ByVal v As Integer = -1) As Boolean
    ' Remembers whether the last hole was made by Hole Wizard, so its counterbore step is skipped.
    Static made As Boolean
    If v >= 0 Then made = (v = 1)
    WizFlag = made
End Function

Sub AddHolePoints(f As Object, p As Variant)
    ' Put the remaining hole centres (model x,y,z in metres) into the Hole Wizard position sketch.
    Dim s As Object, sk As Object, xf As Object, mu As Object, a As Variant, q As Variant, k As Long, n As Long
    On Error Resume Next
    Set s = f.GetFirstSubFeature
    Do While Not s Is Nothing
        If s.GetTypeName2 = "ProfileFeature" Then Exit Do
        Set s = s.GetNextSubFeature
    Loop
    If s Is Nothing Then
        LogLine "  hole positions: no position sketch"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Set sk = s.GetSpecificFeature2
    Set xf = sk.ModelToSketchTransform
    Set mu = swApp.GetMathUtility
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    s.Select2 False, 0
    Part.EditSketch
    sm.AddToDB = True
    For k = 1 To UBound(p)
        q = Split(p(k), ",")
        a = mu.CreatePoint(D3(Val(q(0)), Val(q(1)), Val(q(2)))).MultiplyTransform(xf).ArrayData
        If Not sm.CreatePoint(a(0), a(1), 0) Is Nothing Then n = n + 1
    Next k
    sm.AddToDB = False
    sm.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    Part.ForceRebuild3 False
    LogLine "  hole positions: 1 + " & n & " of " & UBound(p)
    Err.Clear
End Sub

Function MatchesLoose(expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double) As Boolean
    ' Hole Wizard uses standard drill and tap sizes and drill points, so allow a little more.
    Dim mp As Object, c As Variant, v As Double, dx As Double, dy As Double, dz As Double
    MatchesLoose = False
    On Error Resume Next
    Set mp = Part.Extension.CreateMassProperty
    v = mp.Volume * 1E+09
    c = mp.CenterOfMass
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        Err.Clear
        Exit Function
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    If Not IsArray(c) Or v <= 0 Then Exit Function
    dx = c(0) * 1000 - ex: dy = c(1) * 1000 - ey: dz = c(2) * 1000 - ez
    MatchesLoose = (Abs(v - expV) / expV <= 0.005) And (dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz <= 0.25)
End Function

Function HoleWiz(label As String, gtype As Long, fastener As Long, size As String, thru As Boolean, firstEnd As Long, _
                 dia As Double, depth As Double, vals As String, pts As String, dx As Double, dy As Double, dz As Double, _
                 expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double) As Boolean
    ' Hole Wizard, standard JIS (9). Each hole is picked on the face where it starts.
    ' Through holes try Up To Next (2), then Through All (1); the end condition is read back.
    Dim v As Variant, p As Variant, q As Variant, k As Long, tries As Long, endT As Long, f As Object
    Dim a(11) As Double
    HoleWiz = False
    v = Split(vals, ",")
    For k = 0 To 11
        a(k) = Val(v(k))
    Next k
    p = Split(pts, ";")
    For tries = 0 To 1
        If thru Then
            endT = firstEnd
            If tries = 1 Then endT = IIf(firstEnd = 2, 1, 2)
            If gtype = 4 Then a(7) = IIf(endT = 1, 1, 2)
        Else
            If tries = 1 Then Exit Function
            endT = 0
        End If
        ' Hole Wizard takes one position from the selection; the others are added to its sketch.
        Part.ClearSelection2 True
        q = Split(p(0), ",")
        Part.Extension.SelectByRay Val(q(0)) - dx * 0.0001, Val(q(1)) - dy * 0.0001, Val(q(2)) - dz * 0.0001, _
            dx, dy, dz, 0.0002, 2, False, 0, 0
        Set f = Nothing
        On Error Resume Next
        Set f = fm.HoleWizard5(gtype, 9, fastener, size, endT, dia, depth, -1, a(0), a(1), a(2), a(3), a(4), a(5), _
            a(6), a(7), a(8), a(9), a(10), a(11), "", False, True, True, True, True, False)
        On Error GoTo 0
        If Not f Is Nothing Then
            If UBound(p) > 0 Then AddHolePoints f, p
            Part.EditRebuild3
            If MatchesLoose(expV, ex, ey, ez) And (Not thru Or EndIs(f, endT)) Then
                ' Standard drill points and sizes change the volume a little; later checks allow for it.
                VolAdj = VolNow() - expV
                On Error Resume Next
                f.Name = label
                On Error GoTo 0
                Part.ClearSelection2 True
                HoleWiz = True
                Exit Function
            End If
            ' Delete exactly this hole and its position sketch; Undo could remove earlier features.
            On Error Resume Next
            Part.ClearSelection2 True
            f.Select2 False, 0
            Part.Extension.DeleteSelection2 1
            On Error GoTo 0
            Part.EditRebuild3
        End If
    Next tries
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
End Function

Function EndIs(f As Object, endT As Long) As Boolean
    ' A small hole barely changes the volume, so check the end condition itself:
    ' SOLIDWORKS falls back to Blind when it does not take the one asked for.
    Dim d As Object
    EndIs = True
    On Error Resume Next
    Set d = f.GetDefinition
    If Not d Is Nothing Then EndIs = (d.EndCondition = endT)
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

Sub PickEdge(x As Double, y As Double, z As Double)
    ' Remember the edge for a retry, then select it.
    EdgePts = EdgePts & Trim(Str(x)) & "," & Trim(Str(y)) & "," & Trim(Str(z)) & ";"
    PickOne x, y, z
End Sub

Sub PickOne(x As Double, y As Double, z As Double)
    ' Pick by geometry so the result does not depend on the current view.
    Dim b As Variant, e As Variant, p As Variant, sd As Object, i As Long
    Dim dx As Double, dy As Double, dz As Double
    b = Part.GetBodies2(0, False)
    If Not IsArray(b) Then Exit Sub ' no solid yet: an earlier feature failed
    e = b(0).GetEdges
    Set sd = Part.SelectionManager.CreateSelectData
    sd.Mark = 1
    For i = 0 To UBound(e)
        p = e(i).GetClosestPointOn(x, y, z)
        dx = p(0) - x: dy = p(1) - y: dz = p(2) - z
        If dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz < 0.000000000001 Then
            e(i).Select4 True, sd
            Exit Sub
        End If
    Next i
End Sub

Function MakeFinish(isFillet As Boolean, size As Double) As Object
    Dim a0(0) As Double, v As Variant
    a0(0) = 0
    v = a0
    On Error Resume Next
    If isFillet Then
        Set MakeFinish = fm.FeatureFillet3(195, size, size, 0, 0, 0, 0, v, v, v, v, v, v, v)
    Else
        Set MakeFinish = fm.InsertFeatureChamfer(6, 1, size, 0.785398163397448, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    End If
    Err.Clear
End Function

Sub SelectPts(pts As String)
    Dim p As Variant, q As Variant, k As Long
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    p = Split(pts, ";")
    For k = 0 To UBound(p)
        If p(k) <> "" Then
            q = Split(p(k), ",")
            PickOne Val(q(0)), Val(q(1)), Val(q(2))
        End If
    Next k
End Sub

Sub Finish(isFillet As Boolean, label As String, size As Double, expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double)
    ' All picked edges at once. If SOLIDWORKS refuses, keep the edges it accepts one by one
    ' (tested, then made as one feature) and leave the rest sharp.
    Dim f As Object, pts As String, keep As String, p As Variant, k As Long, n As Long, skipped As Long
    pts = EdgePts
    EdgePts = ""
    Set f = MakeFinish(isFillet, size)
    If Not f Is Nothing Then
        Part.EditRebuild3
        f.Name = label
        If Not Matches(expV, ex, ey, ez) Then LogLine "  " & label & ": made, volume " & VolumeNow()
        Exit Sub
    End If
    LogLine "  " & label & ": refused for all edges, trying one by one"
    p = Split(pts, ";")
    For k = 0 To UBound(p)
        If p(k) <> "" Then
            n = n + 1
            SelectPts keep & p(k) & ";"
            Set f = MakeFinish(isFillet, size)
            If f Is Nothing Then
                skipped = skipped + 1
            Else
                keep = keep & p(k) & ";"
                Part.ClearSelection2 True
                f.Select2 False, 0
                Part.Extension.DeleteSelection2 0
                Part.EditRebuild3
            End If
        End If
    Next k
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    If keep <> "" Then
        SelectPts keep
        Set f = MakeFinish(isFillet, size)
        Part.EditRebuild3
        If Not f Is Nothing Then f.Name = label
    End If
    If keep = "" Or f Is Nothing Then
        Problems = Problems & label & " (SOLIDWORKS refused every edge)" & vbCrLf
    ElseIf skipped > 0 Then
        Problems = Problems & label & " (left sharp on " & skipped & " of " & n & " edges)" & vbCrLf
    End If
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
End Sub

Sub FinishFillet(label As String, r As Double, expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double)
    Finish True, label, r, expV, ex, ey, ez
End Sub

Sub FinishChamfer(label As String, d As Double, expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double)
    Finish False, label, d, expV, ex, ey, ez
End Sub

shaft.json.macro:
' AUTO DESIGN 3D macro for SOLIDWORKS 2018 (build 2026-11-16b)
' Tools > Macro > Run, choose this .swb file (or paste it into a new macro).
' It builds the part, then saves Stepped_Shaft.SLDPRT next to this macro.
Option Explicit
Dim swApp As Object
Dim Part As Object
Dim fm As Object
Dim sm As Object
Dim Planes(2) As Object
Dim Problems As String
Dim CurPlane As Long
Dim Kox As Double, Koy As Double, Kux As Double, Kuy As Double, Kvx As Double, Kvy As Double, KMir As Long
Dim EdgePts As String, VolAdj As Double

Sub main()
    Dim tpl As String, folder As String, target As String
    Set swApp = Application.SldWorks
    tpl = swApp.GetUserPreferenceStringValue(8)
    If tpl = "" Then tpl = swApp.GetDocumentTemplate(1, "", 0, 0, 0)
    Set Part = swApp.NewDocument(tpl, 0, 0, 0)
    If Part Is Nothing Then
        MsgBox "Cannot create a new part. Set the default part template in System Options."
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Set fm = Part.FeatureManager
    Set sm = Part.SketchManager
    If Not FindPlanes() Then
        MsgBox "Front, Top and Right planes were not found in the template."
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Step1
    Step2
    Step3
    DefineAllSketches
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    Part.EditRebuild3
    folder = swApp.GetCurrentMacroPathFolder
    target = folder & "\Stepped_Shaft.SLDPRT"
    Part.SaveAs3 target, 0, 1
    If Problems = "" Then
        MsgBox "Done. All features match the STEP model." & vbCrLf & target
    Else
        MsgBox "Saved, but check these features:" & vbCrLf & Problems & vbCrLf & target
    End If
End Sub

Sub Step1()
    Dim nm As String
    BeginSketch OffsetPlane(0, 0.0)
    SkLine 0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 0.01
    SkLine 0.0, 0.01, 0.04, 0.01
    SkLine 0.04, 0.01, 0.04, 0.015
    SkLine 0.04, 0.015, 0.12, 0.015
    SkLine 0.12, 0.015, 0.12, 0.01
    SkLine 0.12, 0.01, 0.16, 0.01
    SkLine 0.16, 0.01, 0.16, 0.0
    SkLine 0.16, 0.0, 0.0, 0.0
    SkCenterLine 0.0, 0.0, 0.1, 0.0
    nm = EndSketch()
    Revolve "Shaft", nm, False, 6.28318530718, 81681.409, 80.0, -0.0, -0.0
End Sub

Sub Step2()
    Dim nm As String
    BeginSketch OffsetPlane(1, 0.015)
    SkArc 0.101, 0.0, 0.101, -0.004, 0.101, 0.004, 1
    SkLine 0.101, 0.004, 0.059, 0.004
    SkArc 0.059, 0.0, 0.059, 0.004, 0.059, -0.004, 1
    SkLine 0.059, -0.004, 0.101, -0.004
    nm = EndSketch()
    Solid "Keyway", nm, True, True, 0, 0, 0.004, 0.0, 0, 0.0, True, 80203.5167, 80.0, -0.238, -0.0
End Sub

Sub Step3()
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    PickEdge 0.0, -0.01, 0.0
    PickEdge 0.12, -0.01, 0.0
    FinishChamfer "End chamfers", 0.001, 80205.6111, 80.0465, -0.238, -0.0
End Sub

Sub LogLine(t As String)
    ' Writes AUTO3D_log.txt next to the macro, to see what SOLIDWORKS did at each step.
    Static started As Boolean
    Dim fn As Integer, path As String
    On Error Resume Next
    path = swApp.GetCurrentMacroPathFolder & "\AUTO3D_log.txt"
    fn = FreeFile
    If started Then
        Open path For Append As #fn
    Else
        Open path For Output As #fn
        started = True
    End If
    Print #fn, t
    Close #fn
    Err.Clear
End Sub

Function FindPlanes() As Boolean
    ' Planes(0) faces Z, Planes(1) faces Y, Planes(2) faces X, whatever the template calls
    ' them, so a Z-up template builds the same part as the standard Y-up one.
    Dim f As Object, n As Long, k As Long, nv As Variant, found(2) As Object
    Set f = Part.FirstFeature
    Do While Not f Is Nothing And n < 3
        If f.GetTypeName2 = "RefPlane" Then
            Set Planes(n) = f
            n = n + 1
            nv = PlaneNormal(f)
            If IsArray(nv) Then LogLine "plane " & f.Name & " normal " & Format(nv(0), "0.00") & ", " & Format(nv(1), "0.00") & ", " & Format(nv(2), "0.00") Else LogLine "plane " & f.Name & " normal unknown"
            If IsArray(nv) Then
                For k = 0 To 2
                    If Abs(nv(2 - k)) > 0.99 Then Set found(k) = f
                Next k
            End If
        End If
        Set f = f.GetNextFeature
    Loop
    If Not found(0) Is Nothing And Not found(1) Is Nothing And Not found(2) Is Nothing Then
        For k = 0 To 2
            Set Planes(k) = found(k)
        Next k
    End If
    LogLine "using " & Planes(0).Name & " (Z), " & Planes(1).Name & " (Y), " & Planes(2).Name & " (X)"
    FindPlanes = (n = 3)
End Function

Function D3(a As Double, b As Double, c As Double) As Variant
    ' SOLIDWORKS math objects need a real Double array; Array() gives Variants and reads as zeros.
    Dim d(2) As Double
    d(0) = a: d(1) = b: d(2) = c
    D3 = d
End Function

Function PlaneNormal(pf As Object) As Variant
    ' Normal of a reference plane in model space, or Empty
    Dim mu As Object, v As Object, a As Variant
    On Error Resume Next
    Set mu = swApp.GetMathUtility
    Set v = mu.CreateVector(D3(0, 0, 1))
    Set v = v.MultiplyTransform(pf.GetSpecificFeature2.Transform)
    a = v.ArrayData
    If IsArray(a) Then
        If Abs(a(0)) + Abs(a(1)) + Abs(a(2)) > 0.5 Then PlaneNormal = a
    End If
    Err.Clear
End Function

Function PlaneOrigin(pf As Object) As Variant
    Dim mu As Object, p As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    Set mu = swApp.GetMathUtility
    Set p = mu.CreatePoint(D3(0, 0, 0))
    Set p = p.MultiplyTransform(pf.GetSpecificFeature2.Transform)
    PlaneOrigin = p.ArrayData
    Err.Clear
End Function

Function OffsetPlane(idx As Long, offM As Double) As Object
    Dim pl As Object, o As Variant
    CurPlane = idx
    If offM <= 0 Then
        Set OffsetPlane = Planes(idx)
        Exit Function
    End If
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    Planes(idx).Select2 False, 0
    Set pl = fm.InsertRefPlane(8, offM, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    ' The offset goes along the template plane's own normal; put it on the +X/+Y/+Z side.
    o = PlaneOrigin(pl)
    If IsArray(o) Then
        If o(2 - idx) < 0 Then
            Part.ClearSelection2 True
            pl.Select2 False, 0
            Part.Extension.DeleteSelection2 0
            Part.ClearSelection2 True
            Planes(idx).Select2 False, 0
            Set pl = fm.InsertRefPlane(8 + 256, offM, 0, 0, 0, 0)
        End If
    End If
    Set OffsetPlane = pl
End Function

Sub BeginSketch(pl As Object)
    Dim ok As Boolean
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    If pl Is Nothing Then
        LogLine "sketch: no plane"
    Else
        ok = pl.Select2(False, 0)
        LogLine "sketch on " & pl.Name & " selected=" & ok
    End If
    sm.InsertSketch True
    LogLine "  active sketch: " & Not (sm.ActiveSketch Is Nothing)
    sm.AddToDB = True
    sm.DisplayWhenAdded = False
    SketchAxes pl
End Sub

Sub SketchAxes(pl As Object)
    ' How this plan's sketch axes (u, v) land in the SOLIDWORKS sketch.
    ' Plan: Front u=X v=Y, Top u=X v=-Z, Right u=-Z v=Y (model X, Y, Z).
    ' A sketch on a plane uses that plane's own x and y axes, read from its transform.
    Dim uu As Variant, vv As Variant, ax As Variant, ay As Variant, o As Variant, d As Double
    Select Case CurPlane
        Case 0: uu = D3(1, 0, 0): vv = D3(0, 1, 0)
        Case 1: uu = D3(1, 0, 0): vv = D3(0, 0, -1)
        Case Else: uu = D3(0, 0, -1): vv = D3(0, 1, 0)
    End Select
    Kox = 0: Koy = 0: Kux = 1: Kuy = 0: Kvx = 0: Kvy = 1: KMir = 1
    ax = PlaneAxis(pl, 1, 0, 0)
    ay = PlaneAxis(pl, 0, 1, 0)
    o = PlaneOrigin(pl)
    If IsArray(ax) And IsArray(ay) And IsArray(o) Then
        LogLine "  plane x=(" & Format(ax(0), "0.00") & ", " & Format(ax(1), "0.00") & ", " & Format(ax(2), "0.00") & ") y=(" & _
            Format(ay(0), "0.00") & ", " & Format(ay(1), "0.00") & ", " & Format(ay(2), "0.00") & ")"
        Kux = Dot3(uu, ax): Kuy = Dot3(uu, ay)
        Kvx = Dot3(vv, ax): Kvy = Dot3(vv, ay)
        Kox = -Dot3(o, ax): Koy = -Dot3(o, ay)
        d = Kux * Kvy - Kuy * Kvx
        If Abs(d) < 0.5 Then
            LogLine "  sketch axes not usable, kept as drawn"
            Kox = 0: Koy = 0: Kux = 1: Kuy = 0: Kvx = 0: Kvy = 1
        ElseIf d < 0 Then
            KMir = -1
        End If
    Else
        LogLine "  plane axes unknown, kept as drawn"
    End If
    LogLine "  axes u=(" & Format(Kux, "0.00") & ", " & Format(Kuy, "0.00") & ") v=(" & Format(Kvx, "0.00") & ", " & Format(Kvy, "0.00") & ") o=(" & Format(Kox * 1000, "0.00") & ", " & Format(Koy * 1000, "0.00") & ")"
End Sub

Function PlaneAxis(pf As Object, x As Double, y As Double, z As Double) As Variant
    ' One axis of a reference plane in model space, or Empty
    Dim mu As Object, v As Object, a As Variant
    On Error Resume Next
    Set mu = swApp.GetMathUtility
    Set v = mu.CreateVector(D3(x, y, z))
    Set v = v.MultiplyTransform(pf.GetSpecificFeature2.Transform)
    a = v.ArrayData
    If IsArray(a) Then
        If Abs(a(0)) + Abs(a(1)) + Abs(a(2)) > 0.5 Then PlaneAxis = a
    End If
    Err.Clear
End Function

Function Dot3(a As Variant, b As Variant) As Double
    Dot3 = a(0) * b(0) + a(1) * b(1) + a(2) * b(2)
End Function

Function SX(u As Double, v As Double) As Double
    SX = Kox + u * Kux + v * Kvx
End Function

Function SY(u As Double, v As Double) As Double
    SY = Koy + u * Kuy + v * Kvy
End Function

Sub SkLine(u1 As Double, v1 As Double, u2 As Double, v2 As Double)
    If sm.CreateLine(SX(u1, v1), SY(u1, v1), 0, SX(u2, v2), SY(u2, v2), 0) Is Nothing Then LogLine "  line failed"
End Sub

Sub SkCenterLine(u1 As Double, v1 As Double, u2 As Double, v2 As Double)
    sm.CreateCenterLine SX(u1, v1), SY(u1, v1), 0, SX(u2, v2), SY(u2, v2), 0
End Sub

Sub SkCircle(cu As Double, cv As Double, r As Double)
    If sm.CreateCircleByRadius(SX(cu, cv), SY(cu, cv), 0, r) Is Nothing Then LogLine "  circle failed"
End Sub

Sub SkArc(cu As Double, cv As Double, au As Double, av As Double, bu As Double, bv As Double, d As Long)
    If sm.CreateArc(SX(cu, cv), SY(cu, cv), 0, SX(au, av), SY(au, av), 0, SX(bu, bv), SY(bu, bv), 0, d * KMir) Is Nothing Then LogLine "  arc failed"
End Sub

Function EndSketch() As String
    sm.AddToDB = False
    sm.DisplayWhenAdded = True
    On Error Resume Next
    LogLine "  segments: " & sm.ActiveSketch.GetSketchSegmentCount
    On Error GoTo 0
    sm.InsertSketch True
    EndSketch = Part.FeatureByPositionReverse(0).Name
    LogLine "  closed as " & EndSketch
End Function

Sub DefineAllSketches()
    ' After the part is built and checked: Tools > Dimensions > Fully Define Sketch on every
    ' sketch, measured from the origin, so sketches turn black with their sizes shown.
    ' Relations: coincident, horizontal, vertical, tangent, perpendicular, concentric.
    ' Any sketch that cannot be defined is left as drawn.
    Dim f As Object, s As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    Set f = Part.FirstFeature
    Do While Not f Is Nothing
        If f.GetTypeName2 = "ProfileFeature" Then DefineOne f
        Set s = f.GetFirstSubFeature
        Do While Not s Is Nothing
            If s.GetTypeName2 = "ProfileFeature" Then DefineOne s
            Set s = s.GetNextSubFeature
        Loop
        Set f = f.GetNextFeature
    Loop
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    Part.EditRebuild3
    Err.Clear
    On Error GoTo 0
End Sub

Sub DefineOne(sk As Object)
    On Error Resume Next
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    If Not sk.Select2(False, 0) Then Exit Sub
    Part.EditSketch
    If sm.ActiveSketch Is Nothing Then Exit Sub
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    Part.Extension.SelectByID2 "Point1@Origin", "EXTSKETCHPOINT", 0, 0, 0, False, 6, Nothing, 0
    sm.FullyDefineSketch True, True, 606, True, 1, Nothing, 1, Nothing, 1, 1
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    sm.InsertSketch True
    Err.Clear
End Sub

Function Matches(expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double) As Boolean
    Dim mp As Object, c As Variant, v As Double, dx As Double, dy As Double, dz As Double
    Matches = False
    On Error Resume Next
    Set mp = Part.Extension.CreateMassProperty
    v = mp.Volume * 1E+09
    c = mp.CenterOfMass
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        Err.Clear
        Exit Function
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    If Not IsArray(c) Or v <= 0 Then Exit Function
    dx = c(0) * 1000 - ex: dy = c(1) * 1000 - ey: dz = c(2) * 1000 - ez
    Matches = (Abs(v - VolAdj - expV) / expV <= 0.0005) And (dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz <= 0.0025)
End Function

Sub Solid(label As String, nm As String, isCut As Boolean, sd As Boolean, t1 As Long, t2 As Long, d1 As Double, _
          dang As Double, t0 As Long, startM As Double, firstDir As Boolean, _
          expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double)
    Dim f As Object, a As Long, b As Long, c As Long, dirFlag As Boolean, fs As Boolean, dOut As Boolean
    Dim useDraft As Boolean, nA As Long, nB As Long, made As Boolean, got As String
    useDraft = (dang > 0)
    nA = 0: If t0 = 3 Then nA = 1
    nB = 0: If useDraft Then nB = 1
    For a = 0 To nA
        For b = 0 To nB
            For c = 0 To 1
                fs = (a = 1): dOut = (b = 1)
                dirFlag = firstDir: If c = 1 Then dirFlag = Not firstDir
                PickSketch nm
                Set f = Nothing
                On Error Resume Next
                If isCut Then
                    Set f = fm.FeatureCut4(sd, False, dirFlag, t1, t2, d1, 0.01, useDraft, False, dOut, False, _
                        IIf(useDraft, dang, 0.0175), 0.0175, False, False, False, False, False, True, True, _
                        True, True, False, t0, startM, fs, False)
                Else
                    Set f = fm.FeatureExtrusion2(sd, False, dirFlag, t1, t2, d1, 0, useDraft, False, dOut, False, _
                        IIf(useDraft, dang, 0.0175), 0.0175, False, False, False, False, True, True, True, _
                        t0, startM, fs)
                End If
                On Error GoTo 0
                If Not f Is Nothing Then
                    made = True
                    Part.EditRebuild3
                    If Matches(expV, ex, ey, ez) Then
                        On Error Resume Next
                        f.Name = label
                        On Error GoTo 0
                        Exit Sub
                    End If
                    got = VolumeNow()
                    Part.EditUndo2 1
                    Part.EditRebuild3
                End If
            Next c
        Next b
    Next a
    LogLine "  " & label & ": made=" & made & " got " & got
    If made Then
        Problems = Problems & label & " (got " & got & ", expected " & Format(expV, "0.0") & " mm3 at " & _
            Format(ex, "0.00") & ", " & Format(ey, "0.00") & ", " & Format(ez, "0.00") & ")" & vbCrLf
    Else
        Problems = Problems & label & " (SOLIDWORKS did not create it, sketch " & nm & ")" & vbCrLf
    End If
End Sub

Function VolNow() As Double
    Dim mp As Object
    On Error Resume Next
    Set mp = Part.Extension.CreateMassProperty

    Err.Clear
End Function

Sub Revolve(label As String, nm As String, isCut As Boolean, ang As Double, expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double)
    Dim f As Object, c As Long
    For c = 0 To 1
        PickSketch nm
        Set f = fm.FeatureRevolve2(True, True, False, isCut, (c = 1), False, 0, 0, ang, 0, False, False, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, True, True, True)
        If Not f Is Nothing Then
            Part.EditRebuild3
            If Matches(expV, ex, ey, ez) Then
                On Error Resume Next
                f.Name = label
                On Error GoTo 0
                Exit Sub
            End If
            Part.EditUndo2 1
            Part.EditRebuild3
        End If
    Next c
    Problems = Problems & label & vbCrLf
End Sub

Function WizFlag(Optional ByVal v As Integer = -1) As Boolean
    ' Remembers whether the last hole was made by Hole Wizard, so its counterbore step is skipped.
    Static made As Boolean
    If v >= 0 Then made = (v = 1)
    WizFlag = made
End Function

Sub AddHolePoints(f As Object, p As Variant)
    ' Put the remaining hole centres (model x,y,z in metres) into the Hole Wizard position sketch.
    Dim s As Object, sk As Object, xf As Object, mu As Object, a As Variant, q As Variant, k As Long, n As Long
    On Error Resume Next
    Set s = f.GetFirstSubFeature
    Do While Not s Is Nothing
        If s.GetTypeName2 = "ProfileFeature" Then Exit Do
        Set s = s.GetNextSubFeature
    Loop
    If s Is Nothing Then
        LogLine "  hole positions: no position sketch"
        Exit Sub
    End If
    Set sk = s.GetSpecificFeature2
    Set xf = sk.ModelToSketchTransform
    Set mu = swApp.GetMathUtility
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    s.Select2 False, 0
    Part.EditSketch
    sm.AddToDB = True
    For k = 1 To UBound(p)
        q = Split(p(k), ",")
        a = mu.CreatePoint(D3(Val(q(0)), Val(q(1)), Val(q(2)))).MultiplyTransform(xf).ArrayData
        If Not sm.CreatePoint(a(0), a(1), 0) Is Nothing Then n = n + 1
    Next k
    sm.AddToDB = False
    sm.InsertSketch True
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    Part.ForceRebuild3 False
    LogLine "  hole positions: 1 + " & n & " of " & UBound(p)
    Err.Clear
End Sub

Function MatchesLoose(expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double) As Boolean
    ' Hole Wizard uses standard drill and tap sizes and drill points, so allow a little more.
    Dim mp As Object, c As Variant, v As Double, dx As Double, dy As Double, dz As Double
    MatchesLoose = False
    On Error Resume Next
    Set mp = Part.Extension.CreateMassProperty
    v = mp.Volume * 1E+09
    c = mp.CenterOfMass
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        Err.Clear
        Exit Function
    End If
    On Error GoTo 0
    If Not IsArray(c) Or v <= 0 Then Exit Function
    dx = c(0) * 1000 - ex: dy = c(1) * 1000 - ey: dz = c(2) * 1000 - ez
    MatchesLoose = (Abs(v - expV) / expV <= 0.005) And (dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz <= 0.25)
End Function

Function HoleWiz(label As String, gtype As Long, fastener As Long, size As String, thru As Boolean, firstEnd As Long, _
                 dia As Double, depth As Double, vals As String, pts As String, dx As Double, dy As Double, dz As Double, _
                 expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double) As Boolean
    ' Hole Wizard, standard JIS (9). Each hole is picked on the face where it starts.
    ' Through holes try Up To Next (2), then Through All (1); the end condition is read back.
    Dim v As Variant, p As Variant, q As Variant, k As Long, tries As Long, endT As Long, f As Object
    Dim a(11) As Double
    HoleWiz = False
    v = Split(vals, ",")
    For k = 0 To 11
        a(k) = Val(v(k))
    Next k
    p = Split(pts, ";")
    For tries = 0 To 1
        If thru Then
            endT = firstEnd
            If tries = 1 Then endT = IIf(firstEnd = 2, 1, 2)
            If gtype = 4 Then a(7) = IIf(endT = 1, 1, 2)
        Else
            If tries = 1 Then Exit Function
            endT = 0
        End If
        ' Hole Wizard takes one position from the selection; the others are added to its sketch.
        Part.ClearSelection2 True
        q = Split(p(0), ",")
        Part.Extension.SelectByRay Val(q(0)) - dx * 0.0001, Val(q(1)) - dy * 0.0001, Val(q(2)) - dz * 0.0001, _
            dx, dy, dz, 0.0002, 2, False, 0, 0
        Set f = Nothing
        On Error Resume Next
        Set f = fm.HoleWizard5(gtype, 9, fastener, size, endT, dia, depth, -1, a(0), a(1), a(2), a(3), a(4), a(5), _
            a(6), a(7), a(8), a(9), a(10), a(11), "", False, True, True, True, True, False)
        On Error GoTo 0
        If Not f Is Nothing Then
            If UBound(p) > 0 Then AddHolePoints f, p
            Part.EditRebuild3
            If MatchesLoose(expV, ex, ey, ez) And (Not thru Or EndIs(f, endT)) Then
                ' Standard drill points and sizes change the volume a little; later checks allow for it.
                VolAdj = VolNow() - expV
                On Error Resume Next
                f.Name = label
                On Error GoTo 0
                Part.ClearSelection2 True
                HoleWiz = True
                Exit Function
            End If
            ' Delete exactly this hole and its position sketch; Undo could remove earlier features.
            On Error Resume Next
            Part.ClearSelection2 True
            f.Select2 False, 0
            Part.Extension.DeleteSelection2 1
            On Error GoTo 0
            Part.EditRebuild3
        End If
    Next tries
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
End Function

Function EndIs(f As Object, endT As Long) As Boolean
    ' A small hole barely changes the volume, so check the end condition itself:
    ' SOLIDWORKS falls back to Blind when it does not take the one asked for.
    Dim d As Object
    EndIs = True
    On Error Resume Next
    Set d = f.GetDefinition
    If Not d Is Nothing Then EndIs = (d.EndCondition = endT)
    On Error GoTo 0
End Function

Sub PickEdge(x As Double, y As Double, z As Double)
    ' Remember the edge for a retry, then select it.
    EdgePts = EdgePts & Trim(Str(x)) & "," & Trim(Str(y)) & "," & Trim(Str(z)) & ";"
    PickOne x, y, z
End Sub

Sub PickOne(x As Double, y As Double, z As Double)
    ' Pick by geometry so the result does not depend on the current view.
    Dim b As Variant, e As Variant, p As Variant, sd As Object, i As Long
    Dim dx As Double, dy As Double, dz As Double
    b = Part.GetBodies2(0, False)
    If Not IsArray(b) Then Exit Sub ' no solid yet: an earlier feature failed
    e = b(0).GetEdges
    Set sd = Part.SelectionManager.CreateSelectData
    sd.Mark = 1
    For i = 0 To UBound(e)
        p = e(i).GetClosestPointOn(x, y, z)
        dx = p(0) - x: dy = p(1) - y: dz = p(2) - z
        If dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz < 0.000000000001 Then
            e(i).Select4 True, sd
            Exit Sub
        End If
    Next i
End Sub

Function MakeFinish(isFillet As Boolean, size As Double) As Object
    Dim a0(0) As Double, v As Variant
    a0(0) = 0
    v = a0
    On Error Resume Next
    If isFillet Then
        Set MakeFinish = fm.FeatureFillet3(195, size, size, 0, 0, 0, 0, v, v, v, v, v, v, v)
    Else
        Set MakeFinish = fm.InsertFeatureChamfer(6, 1, size, 0.785398163397448, 0, 0, 0, 0)
    End If
    Err.Clear
End Function

Sub SelectPts(pts As String)
    Dim p As Variant, q As Variant, k As Long
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    p = Split(pts, ";")
    For k = 0 To UBound(p)
        If p(k) <> "" Then
            q = Split(p(k), ",")
            PickOne Val(q(0)), Val(q(1)), Val(q(2))
        End If
    Next k
End Sub

Sub Finish(isFillet As Boolean, label As String, size As Double, expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double)
    ' All picked edges at once. If SOLIDWORKS refuses, keep the edges it accepts one by one
    ' (tested, then made as one feature) and leave the rest sharp.
    Dim f As Object, pts As String, keep As String, p As Variant, k As Long, n As Long, skipped As Long
    pts = EdgePts
    EdgePts = ""
    Set f = MakeFinish(isFillet, size)
    If Not f Is Nothing Then
        Part.EditRebuild3
        f.Name = label
        If Not Matches(expV, ex, ey, ez) Then LogLine "  " & label & ": made, volume " & VolumeNow()
        Exit Sub
    End If
    LogLine "  " & label & ": refused for all edges, trying one by one"
    p = Split(pts, ";")
    For k = 0 To UBound(p)
        If p(k) <> "" Then
            n = n + 1
            SelectPts keep & p(k) & ";"
            Set f = MakeFinish(isFillet, size)
            If f Is Nothing Then
                skipped = skipped + 1
            Else
                keep = keep & p(k) & ";"
                Part.ClearSelection2 True
                f.Select2 False, 0
                Part.Extension.DeleteSelection2 0
                Part.EditRebuild3
            End If
        End If
    Next k
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
    If keep <> "" Then
        SelectPts keep
        Set f = MakeFinish(isFillet, size)
        Part.EditRebuild3
        If Not f Is Nothing Then f.Name = label
    End If
    If keep = "" Or f Is Nothing Then
        Problems = Problems & label & " (SOLIDWORKS refused every edge)" & vbCrLf
    ElseIf skipped > 0 Then
        Problems = Problems & label & " (left sharp on " & skipped & " of " & n & " edges)" & vbCrLf
    End If
    Part.ClearSelection2 True
End Sub

Sub FinishFillet(label As String, r As Double, expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double)
    Finish True, label, r, expV, ex, ey, ez
End Sub

Sub FinishChamfer(label As String, d As Double, expV As Double, ex As Double, ey As Double, ez As Double)
    Finish False, label, d, expV, ex, ey, ez
End Sub
